summary: Remains of Samantha Bartolo, 40, of Delta, found near Smith Mountain Trailhead east of Delta; reported missing by family Nov 12, 2023; SAR teams from Delta, Montrose, Mesa, Gunnison and San Miguel Counties had searched the H-75 Rd / Gunnison Gorge NCA area without locating her; Delta County Coroner investigating death as suspicious pending autopsy.
location: Smith Mountain Trailhead, east of Delta
notes: Run 1008: KVNF Regional Newscast Feb 29, 2024 — remains found Feb 18 (Sunday); missing since Nov 12, 2023; five-county SAR search around H-75 Rd / Gunnison Gorge NCA; death investigated as suspicious pending autopsy. Date is the remains-found date per the id-2767 missing-person-found-deceased precedent.
